text.site_description: Luke Watson is a Lubbock, Texas artist and graphic designer. Original wildlife paintings, graphic design, and how to get in touch.
text.hero_lede: Artist and graphic designer working out of Lubbock, TX.
text.about_p1: Luke Watson is a Lubbock, Texas–based artist and graphic designer — two practices that come back to the same instinct: build a clear, honest image, then push it until it's fun to look at.
text.about_p2: A Texas Tech University alumnus, Luke brings a designer's eye to everything he makes. In the studio, he hand-renders wildlife and West Texas scenery in bold black-and-white linework, set against loose, colorful backgrounds that feel more spray can than still life.
text.about_p3: Call him a happy camper — that outdoor-first, low-key attitude runs through everything he makes, whether it's a brand for a client or a bear standing tall in a field of color. If it doesn't feel a little alive, it's not done yet.
text.art_intro: Originals are one of one — reach out below for pricing and availability.
text.contact_intro: Commission a piece, order a print, book Luke for a project, or just say hi — fill out the form and he'll get back to you.
